settings.title: What surfaces do your restoration kits work on?
settings.content: Our restoration compounds and polishes are specifically formulated for marine gelcoat and fiberglass surfaces. They're effective on boats, yachts, jet skis, and other marine vessels. The complete system handles everything from heavy oxidation removal to final high-gloss finishing.

settings.title: How long does the sealant protection last?
settings.content: Our marine sealants provide durable protection that can last 6-12 months depending on environmental conditions and maintenance. In harsh saltwater environments with proper application, you can expect reliable UV protection and hydrophobic performance throughout the boating season.

settings.title: Do you offer dealer pricing and wholesale accounts?
settings.content: Yes! We offer competitive dealer pricing with tiered volume discounts. Fill out the inquiry form below to get started. Our dealer team will provide a custom quote based on your business needs and projected volume within 24 hours.

settings.title: What's included in a typical restoration kit?
settings.content: Our restoration kits include a complete system approach: heavy-cut compound for oxidation removal, medium-cut polish for defect correction, finishing polish for high-gloss results, and a protective sealant for long-lasting protection. Kits can be customized for dealer accounts based on your most common job types.

settings.title: What kind of support do you provide to dealers?
settings.content: Authorized dealers receive product training materials, technical support from our marine restoration specialists, co-branded marketing materials, priority fulfillment, and dedicated account management. We're invested in helping your business grow.
